observations: Structured library identity combines catalog observation identity or physical path plus vendor product identity; instrument identity is scoped to its installation and uses vendor identity or path. Shared metadata containers and separate installations remain distinct.

Sample root matching respects path component boundaries and chooses the most specific configured root; directory projection uses discovered paths only. Name, size and reference-recency sorting apply to sample siblings and flat search results.
Library filtering matches individual patch names/tags separately from aggregate library metadata; matching ancestors retain context and library-only matches carry explicit metadata-only labels.

Per-category browse state is separate from temporary query state. Cached base projection survives query changes, invalidates on inventory/root/sort changes, and reconciles locator identities when persistence first assigns catalog IDs.
Native refresh suppresses callback recording while rebuilding outline rows, restores explicit/default expansion and visible selection, and clears legacy selectedPath for group selections.

Library/instrument storage and usage text remains unknown/shared; cached/stale labels persist. Finder uses actual recorded paths and maker/unidentified groups have no target. Plugin removal authority checks remain in the existing model and format-management boundary.

outline_state has one runtime registry definition, explicit policies for all concerns, empty default and nondefault reset coverage. Setup serialization uses registry-selected persisted IDs and excludes outline navigation without a schema change.
